description: Differences between a live-edited Result and the Result Generate draws from the same draft that PD-OI-066 allows. Read by tests/web/helpers/live-generate-parity.cjs. An entry applies to a difference of its kind and one of its attributes when every condition field equals the difference's context: the live Result's mode, resultIndex, and resultCount, and labelDrawnInBoth (the feature's label is drawn live and after Generate). Each entry cites the decision or rule that allows it; add one only with such a citation.
